dedicated.story:
"I believe that one can only call themselves a knight if they uphold the duties inherent to that title. For example, if a knight stoops to thievery, can they still truly be called a knight?"

At the training grounds, Rook revealed to Chancellor that he joined the guard to protect his younger siblings. In turn, Chancellor revealed his own secret, admitting that rather than taking the easy path, he concealed his highborn origins and threw himself into rigorous training to become a true knight. Chancellor highlighted that what matters is not status or standing, but fulfilling one's duty, and together he and Rook reaffirmed the ethos they must carry as knights.

lore:
Chancellor was born to a small noble family that ruled over a territory on the outskirts of Terra Kingdom. He voluntarily joined the armed forces because he looked up to noble knights like Kris and Knox.
His easygoing, unflappable attitude and his higher-than-average tenacity made him a fantastic soldier. Before long, he had been appointed as the captain of his watch.
From there, he steadily climbed the ranks, becoming the captain of the whole guard corps. As the new guard captain, he was introduced to Rook.
Chancellor was inspired by Rook's performance and his unchanging attitude and compared it against his own — arriving at the conclusion that he'd become weak and lazy.
He also remembered the monumental efforts of both Kris and Knox, leading him to redouble his training.
There were rumors that Chancellor had gotten to his position because of his pretty face and honeyed words, but those quickly faded when the knight proved himself time and time again. Once he'd caught a number of high-profile spies in one fell swoop, no one questioned his ability any longer.
Soon, he was appointed to the position of captain of the castle guard, to much fanfare and celebration from his fellow knights.
He immediately put in a recommendation for his fellow knight Rook, who has joined him on the castle guard ever since.
